contributor to MP (1882-98)

She was author of One Only (1874), Valentina  (1882), A Lost Battle (1878) and about 50 other titles to 1932. She was one of the co-authors (with CMY) of The Miz-Maze, and evidently a friend of Amelie Leroy and Anna Bramston’s. [norg@mc2.vicnet.net.au Mr Norman Gardiner, who is studying her; COPAC]
